description: An unmodified-API example from official MarkupSafe 1.1.1 API documentation evaluated against pinned 2.1.5 source, plus a healthy control. A declared historical version migration, not a bug in current upstream documentation.

target_runtime.implementation_variant: bundled native Python fallback; no compiled extension

provenance.case_selection: Newly mined from official upstream documentation for this evaluation; no live model has been run during case preparation. Final freeze and cross-condition execution are recorded separately.

limitations: One selected removed-API migration is not representative of arbitrary MarkupSafe defects.
The old documentation is paired intentionally with a newer library; no claim that current upstream documentation is broken.
Sphinx docstring examples require public module scope; setup supplies that scope.
Doctest expression display is mechanically translated into print(repr(...)) because the tool only accepts fenced Python.
The historical library version was not executed; source provenance and the official change log document the migration.
Finite checks and doctest output do not prove general semantic equivalence.

cases.title: Preserve safe text on string conversion
cases.expected_failure: NameError: soft_unicode is absent from the documented public module namespace in MarkupSafe 2.1.5.
